question: How many users are there in each age category (20s, 30s, 40s, 50s, and others)?
sql:
WITH distinct_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id, sex, birth_date
  FROM mst_users
),
age_category AS (
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    sex,
    birth_date,
    CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', CAST(birth_date AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) AS birth_year,
    CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_DATE) AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', CAST(birth_date AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) AS age
  FROM distinct_users
)
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN age BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN '20s'
    WHEN age BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN '30s'
    WHEN age BETWEEN 40 AND 49 THEN '40s'
    WHEN age BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN '50s'
    ELSE 'others'
  END AS age_category,
  COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM age_category
GROUP BY 
  CASE 
    WHEN age BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN '20s'
    WHEN age BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN '30s'
    WHEN age BETWEEN 40 AND 49 THEN '40s'
    WHEN age BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN '50s'
    ELSE 'others'
  END
ORDER BY age_category
